mechanism: 추출합니다 and quantifies 기능어 (determiners, prepositions, conjunctions, auxiliary verbs, 대명사s) 는 constitute ~50% of typical English text. These 'style words' are produced largely unconsciously by humans and carry strong authorial fingerprints. parameters: Function word list: 300+ closed-class words, Metric: Burrows's Delta, z-score normalization, Granularity: per-paragraph, Reference: balanced human corpus
